Foundation Policy Register

One register. Eleven categories.

Each policy holds a permanent number in the Foundation Policy Architecture, set out in Schedule 1 of Policy 03. A number is never reused for an unrelated subject, so Policy 27 always means Startup Incubation. Select any number to open that policy.

—Point at a number to see its policy.

Governing hierarchy

Where the policies sit

Policy 03 sets the order of authority. Where two sources conflict, the higher one controls. The principal policies sit beneath the law and the Foundation's constitution, and above the procedures and forms that put them into practice.

  1. 1
    Applicable lawLaws, rules, binding notifications, regulatory orders and court or tribunal directions
  2. 2
    Section 8 licence conditionsConditions of the Foundation's Section 8 licence
  3. 3
    Memorandum of Association
  4. 4
    Articles of Association
  5. 5
    Member and Board resolutionsValid resolutions, each within the authority allocated to that body
  6. 6
    Policy 01: Governance and Section 8 Compliance
  7. 7
    The other principal PoliciesEach controls its allocated subject. No policy ranks above another because of its number.
  8. 8
    Matrices, charters, procedures and formsDelegation matrices, committee charters, schedules, procedures, manuals, templates, forms and guidance

Single source of truth

The Authoritative Repository and the Master Policy Register determine the current approved Version and Release.

Policy 03 · Document-Governance Principles

Architecture separate from state

Schedule 1 records what the policy suite is. The Master Policy Register records where each policy currently stands.

Policy 03 · Document-Governance Principles

Stable numbering

The Policy number is permanent. Title changes are controlled through Schedule 1 and recorded in the Master Policy Register.
